title: Week 8
description: SDN for IoT (contd), Data Handling and Analytics, Cloud Computing

questions.question: Which of the following is listed as a problem in traditional (non-SDN) mobile networks?
options: Difficult to scale due to static, over-provisioned networks

questions.question: In the ODIN architecture for software-defined wireless networks, what does the 'Odin agent' do?
options: It is placed at the controller end to manage policies
It replaces the OpenFlow protocol entirely
It is placed with the physical devices to communicate with the controller
It performs billing for cloud resources

questions.question: What is the primary goal of Mobi-Flow's proactive rule placement approach in Software-Defined IoT?
options: To place flow-rules randomly across all access points
To predict users' future location and place flow-rules at APs accordingly
To eliminate the need for a controller
To increase the number of PACKET-IN messages

questions.question: Which simulation tool is mentioned in the lecture for experimenting with wireless software-defined networks, supporting both wired and wireless (IEEE 802.11) protocols?
According to the NIST definition quoted in the lecture, cloud computing enables on-demand network access to a shared pool of what?
Which of the following is one of the essential characteristics of cloud computing as defined by NIST?
Which cloud deployment model is set up for the exclusive use of a single organization, typically managed on-premises or by a third party off-premises?
Which of the following is given as an example of a public cloud provider in the lecture?
options: A company's internal private data center
A single organization's dedicated server room
A community-only cloud shared by hospitals

questions.question: Which cloud service model provides on-demand delivery of computing infrastructure such as servers, storage, network, and operating system?
In the IaaS working methodology, which component allows multiple virtual machines to share the same physical hardware?
Which cloud service model is described as 'application middleware offered as a service to developers', removing the need to manage underlying hardware and operating systems?
What is the primary purpose of a Service Level Agreement (SLA) in cloud service management?
options: To define the physical location of the data center
To define the non-functional requirements expected from the service provider
To specify the programming language used by the cloud provider
To list the hardware vendors used by the provider

questions.question: In cloud service accounting and billing, what does 'service accounting' primarily aim to obtain?
options: Resource usage information, typically in the form of records
The source code of hosted applications
The marketing budget of the provider

questions.question: What is the main purpose of using cloud simulators such as CloudSim before actual deployment?
options: To permanently replace the need for real cloud infrastructure
To increase the billing cost of cloud services
To provide a reliable, scalable, and repeatable environment for pre-deployment performance evaluation

questions.question: CloudSim, a widely used cloud simulation framework, was developed at which institution and is based on which programming language?
options: CLOUDS Lab, University of Melbourne, based on Java
